items.desc_now: OMK helps people and agents build, maintain, and reuse valuable knowledge from real work and collaboration, with readable content, traceable sources, and revision history for future tasks.
items.desc_prev: OMK — Evidence-backed evaluation and observability for prompts, RAG, skills, agents, and workflows. Native Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness support.

items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：按闲置天数自动归档会话，补齐 DSH 只有手动 Archive 的缺口；回到会话自动取消归档，配合「按最近活跃」排序让老会话回到顶部。支持演练模式、置顶保护、排除清单、跟随主题的折叠设置卡片、归档历史与逐条撤销，归档走原生状态，不删任何数据。
items.desc_prev: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：按闲置天数自动归档会话，补齐 DSH 只有手动 Archive 的缺口。支持演练模式、置顶保护、排除清单、审计日志与逐条撤销，归档走原生状态，不删任何数据。A DSH plugin that auto-archives idle sessions after a configurable number of days — dry-run mode, pinned-session protection, exclusion list, audit log and per-item undo, using DSH native archive state.
